bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
repo=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
image="$(docker inspect --format '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)"
test "$image" = "sha256:154501363ed5c7dd9bcfa66a506450410ccec76553fc08b117aec0e903e4c60a" || exit 70
test "$(docker inspect --format '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 71
before="$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)"
enabled_before="$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)"
test "$before" = active || exit 72
if (cd "$repo" && timeout 60s python3 scripts/userbot_test_client.py bot_start_menu >/dev/null 2>&1); then smoke=PASS; else smoke=FAIL; fi
after="$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service || true)"
enabled_after="$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service || true)"
{ echo "CHAT_SELECTOR_REGRESSION_SMOKE=$smoke"; echo "GAYBBS_IMAGE=$image"; echo "USERBOT_ACTIVE_BEFORE=$before"; echo "USERBOT_ACTIVE_AFTER=$after"; echo "USERBOT_ENABLED_BEFORE=$enabled_before"; echo "USERBOT_ENABLED_AFTER=$enabled_after"; } | gh issue comment 7 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --body-file - >/dev/null
test "$smoke" = PASS && test "$after" = active && test "$enabled_before" = "$enabled_after"
